name: Stripe MCP Server
summary: Stripe's hosted remote MCP server giving agents OAuth-secured access to the Stripe API and documentation.
description: Connect MCP clients to https://mcp.stripe.com with OAuth (recommended for interactive clients) or, for autonomous clients, an agent API key (shown with the Agent badge in the Dashboard) as a Bearer token. Stripe says to migrate by November 30, 2026: from December the server stops accepting full-access secret keys and restricted API keys without the Agent tag, and such requests get a 401 with an OAuth discovery challenge. Tools include stripe_api_search, stripe_api_details, stripe_api_read (any GET method) and stripe_api_write (POST, PATCH, PUT and DELETE), plus account and documentation tools; Stripe recommends turning on tool approval in your client.
